title: Ammonium formate-engineered MA-free perovskite inks for solar cells and optoelectronic devices
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00069F, Paper
Reza Ghayoor, Fatemeh Ghasemi, Leyla Shooshtari, Fariba Tajabadi, Raheleh Mohammadpour, Nima Taghavinia
Stable perovskite inks with ammonium formate enable efficient carbon-based solar cells and high-performance self-powered photodetectors, offering promising ink durability and long-term device stability.
